scope: Conditional candidate preparation from existing four-consequence supply,669 definition and512 closure only; current route read. No1126 accounts/results/images, fresh body, source gloss, reserve, infrastructure or registry mutation.
interpretation_of_same_root: The same reusable written constituent, not a claimed botanical species or a confirmed anatomical ROOT lexeme. If anatomical root was intended, the same limitation applies: depicting an organ does not identify what its inscription says.
selected_minimum: An independently written owner choice within one complete owned construction: two distinct parent-record references W_A and W_B, one bound part mention p, and a fixed reused construction requiring PART_OF(p,W_A), with the contrary PART_OF(p,W_B) excluded by independent ownership. W_A/W_B can remain opaque record IDs; no botanical species or different-kind inference is required.
minimum_components: A complete owned unit with both competing parent-record mentions and the part mention.
A predeclared finite written construction that actually supplies and selects its owner argument; no pictured-owner default.
An independent inscription/depiction-to-record binding establishing which parent record owns the part, rather than semantic proximity or text chosen for fit.
All intervening groups and scopes accounted for or UNKNOWN; any unknown capable of replacing/selecting an owner makes the comparison nondecisive.
Frozen name-only and relational constructions, charged residual/allomorph/context rules; no change after inspecting the consequence.

countermodels.NAME_ONLY: NAME(K) identifies a plant kind; a part can legitimately carry that same plant name. With no owner argument this constructor does not select a particular parent record.
countermodels.RELATIONAL: PART_OF(p,W) explicitly binds a part to a parent record under its fixed written argument rule. Changing W changes this assertion.
countermodels.NAME_WITH_WRAPPER: NAME(K) can combine with a separately written PART_OF/owner wrapper. It can make the same owner prediction as RELATIONAL while the shared written root still means a plant name. This surviving factorization prevents root-semantic selection.

what_outcomes_change.wrong_owner: Reject only the exact frozen relational owner rule if it selects W_B; unknown owner scope is missing binding instead.
what_outcomes_change.correct_owner: Reject a strictly unary NAME_ONLY proposal only if it claimed to supply that same owner-selection duty without another paid construction. Retain NAME_WITH_WRAPPER and the relational factorization; no root word meaning selected.
what_outcomes_change.no_independent_owner_choice: STOP: do not author or run a model intended to choose name-versus-part from anatomy, root repetition or arity stipulation alone.

why_single_whole_part_pair_does_not_deci: NAME(K) may label a whole plant or its root/leaf material; PART_OF(p,K) may label the corresponding part. Both support the same visual correspondence. Register morphology can modify either. Native same-plant/organ capacity therefore cannot be promoted to an observable lexical distinction.
current_input_availability: The four-consequence file states that owner-relative morphology, written binding and crossed endpoints are missing.669 likewise retains a missing independently readable organ/process and legitimate text-to-drawing relation. No exact existing written owner-choice example is supplied in these permitted inputs. This is a bounded input conclusion, not an absence claim for the registry/manuscript.
idea512_retained: The complete29group offered account keeps a conditional single-material lineage but does not bind depiction time or derive terminal recognizable organs. The added fine-powder recognition bridge conflicts with a ROOT+LEAF terminal image; initial or source-kind depiction remains compatible. That conditional failure tests endpoint/stage interpretation, not NAME(K) versus PART_OF, and cannot donate a new owner relation or processing gloss.
no_selection: No raw card added, no test GO, no constructor preference or native anatomy conclusion. The minimum is an eligibility specification, not a discovered observation.
